paite: "Bangkim hihthei, TOUPA Pathian in thu agen a, leitung nisuahna lam a kipan a atumna lam tan in asamta hi.
heading: Asaph La / Biakna Dik
english: A Psalm by Asaph. The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.

paite: Kilawm bukim, Zion a kipan in Pathian avakkhia hi.
english: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.

paite: "I Pathian ahong ding a, adai nilouh kei ding; amah ma ah mei akuang zuazua ding a, akim ah huihpi anung ding hi.
english: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.

paite: Amite vai ahawmtheihna ding in tunglam vante leh lei asam ding.
english: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:

paite: Ka misiangthoute ka kiang ah pikhawm unla, kithoih a thukhungte ngei," chi in.
english: “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”

paite: Huchi in vante'n adiktatna atangkoupih ding ua, amah Pathian ngei vaihawmpa ahi ngal a. Selah
english: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.

paite: "Ka mite aw, ngaikhia unla, thu ka gen ding hi; Israel aw, ngaikhia in, ka hon hilhchiansak ding hi; kei Pathian, na Pathian ngeingei ka hi.
english: “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.

paite: Na kithoihnate ziak in ka hon tai kei ding; ka ma ah na halmang thillatte a-om gige ngal a.
english: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.

paite: Na inn a kipan bawngtal ka lakhe kei ding a, na ganhuang a kipan keltalte ka lakhe sam kei ding hi.
english: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.

paite: Gamnuai a sa chiteng kei a ahi a, mual sangkhat tung a gan omte leng.
english: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.

paite: Tang a vasa tengteng ka thei vek a; gamsate kei' a ahi.
english: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.

paite: "Gilkial mah leng ka hon hilh kei ding, leitung leh asung a thil om tengteng kei' a ahi.
english: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

paite: Bawngtal sa ka ne in kel sisan ka dawn dia hiam?
english: Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

paite: Pathian kiang ah kipahthugen kithoihna lan zaw inla; na thuchiam leng Tungnungpen lak ah tangtun in.
english: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.

paite: Huan mangbat ni in hon sam lechin, ka hon humbit ding a, huchi in nang na hon pahtawi ding hi, achi a.
english: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

paite: "Migilou-salou kiang ah bel, Pathian in, Ka dan thuseh bangchidan a na kam a lou na hia?
english: But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,

paite: Thuhilhna na hua a, ka thute na nunglam ah na pai zel ngal a.
english: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?

paite: Guta na muh in phaze na sakpih a, angkawmpate na koppih gige behlap hi.
english: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.

paite: "Gilou kiang ah na kam na pia a, Na lei in khemna a bawl gige hi.
english: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.

paite: Tu kawm in na unau na kalh a; nangmah nu tapa ngei na hek hi.
english: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.

paite: Huai thil na hih a, himahleh ka dai nilouh a; nangmah bang geih in na hon gingta hi. Himahleh ka hon tai a, na mitmuh in kizom zel in ka hihlang ding hi.
english: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.

paite: "Nou Pathian mangngilhte aw, hiai ngaihtuah dih ua! Huchi lou in zaw ka hon botnen kha ding hi, noumau hon humbit ding lah a om dek ngal kei hi.
english: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.

paite: Kuapeuh kipahthugen kithoihna lan in ahon pahtawi zel hi, huan a-omdan kemhoihmi kiang ah Pathian hotdamna ka ensak ding hi,” achi a.
english: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”
